'''Cosmoram''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Galewether]] at 36 stars after completing their specific evolution trials.

==Overview==
Current Description: "No longer driving others away with furious lightning, Cosmoram can now hang silently in the sky as a glowing celestial body. No small talk needed to keep everyone company. Might as well be a warm night light."

Cosmoram is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A sleeping sheep that hovers in the air above three lightning bolts. Its body is covered in white wool that's yellow-orange at the ends and resembles clouds. It also has orange hooves and orange- and brown-striped, ram-like horns. Its skin is a deep blue, and it has long, floppy ears.

Cosmoram's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with purple.

== Trivia ==
* Cosmoram was added to the game on 6/3/2026 alongside [[Momopo]] and [[Heliabloom]].
